title: ophrys holosericea subsp. helios
intro: Ophrys holosericea subsp. helios, commonly known as the helios bee orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family, characterized by its unique appearance and fragrance that mimics female bees to attract pollinators. The helios bee orchid has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as wounds, infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exert antifungal properties, making it a valuable resource in the treatment of various health disorders. The bioactive constituents of Ophrys holosericea subsp. helios include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
